slides.title: It's 10pm and the sink is full. Don't do all the dishes. Do this.
Make three stacks
slides.body: Cups, plates, everything else. Stacks look smaller than a pile.

slides.title: Wash cups only
slides.body: Cups are fast and they run out first. Done in a few minutes.

slides.title: Soak the rest
slides.body: Hot water and soap in the pans. Tomorrow-you gets a head start.

slides.title: Clear one side of the sink
slides.body: One empty side means tomorrow's dishes have somewhere to go.

slides.title: Turn the light off and leave
slides.body: No guilt loop. The plan is done, so you're done.

slides.title: A half-done sink is still a sink that's better than an hour ago.
Want the full evening reset?
slides.body: It's in The Messy Brain Home Reset, our 7-day shame-free home reset. Link in bio.
